note: Frozen BEFORE any calibration data is viewed (Protocol V2.3 rev3 Section 5 ordering rule). These standards govern the six-contrast method-choice rule and the distribution-family validation. Changing any value after viewing calibration data is prohibited; any change creates a new version with explicit rationale.

symmetry_diagnostic.rule: For each of the six contrast sets (H1-H4 + S1 two components), compute the sample skewness of task-level paired R_task differences. |skewness| <= 1.0 on ALL SIX sets => sign-flip is the unified method. Any set exceeding 1.0 triggers the paired-t applicability check below.
symmetry_diagnostic.note: Threshold 1.0 is a moderate asymmetry threshold: below it, the sign-flip test's exactness claim is reasonable; above it, we check whether paired-t is applicable instead.

paired_t_applicability.finite_variance: Sample variance is finite and > 0 for all six contrast sets (guaranteed by finite R_task values, but asserted).
paired_t_applicability.sample_size_rule: Each contrast set must have >= 30 paired differences. Below 30: stop-confirmatory-admission applies (Protocol V2.3 Section 5 rule iii).

outlier_criterion.rule: Any |paired difference| > Q3 + 3*IQR or < Q1 - 3*IQR is flagged. Flagged values are RETAINED (never removed). If flagged values constitute > 10% of any contrast set, the set's t-applicability is re-checked via a sensitivity analysis (results with and without flagged values).

paired_t_applicability.skewness_tolerance: For paired-t to be applicable under asymmetry, the sample size must be >= 30 AND |skewness| <= 2.0 (beyond this, the t-statistic's sampling distribution is too non-normal for reliable inference at these sample sizes).

distribution_family_validation.multiple_testing: Bonferroni within each (node, model) cell (2 tests per cell)
distribution_family_validation.selection_rule: If neither family passes (p >= 0.01 after Bonferroni), the cell uses 'empirical' (no parametric E1; on-time probability from empirical CDF).
distribution_family_validation.estimator_binding: The selected family per cell is frozen in PRIORS_REAL_V1.json and cannot be changed after confirmation data is collected.

contention_calibration.probe_design: 2 tasks sharing the stub executor with known service profiles; measure wall time of the delayed task vs its solo wall time; repeat >= 20 trials with distinct task pairs.
contention_calibration.output: contention_ratio = (shared_wall - solo_wall) / solo_wall; the frozen contention multiplier for PRIORS_REAL_V1.
contention_calibration.applicability: Ratio measured on stub profiles with KNOWN service times; the ratio (not the absolute) transfers to real profiles.

missing_data_rule.rule: Any (task, arm) pair with a missing R_task value (infrastructure failure, crash, budget stop) is EXCLUDED from all six contrast sets for that task. The exclusion count per arm is reported. If > 10% of tasks are excluded from any contrast set, the confirmatory analysis is flagged with a completeness warning.
missing_data_rule.no_imputation: No imputation, no zero-fill, no mean-fill. Missing is missing.

method_choice_procedure.step_1: Compute skewness for all six contrast sets on calibration/validation data.
method_choice_procedure.step_2: If ALL SIX |skewness| <= 1.0 => unified sign-flip (MC B=1e5). Done.
method_choice_procedure.step_3: Else check paired-t applicability on ALL SIX sets (finite variance, n>=30, |skewness|<=2.0, outlier sensitivity passes).
method_choice_procedure.step_4: If ALL SIX pass => unified one-sided paired t. Done.
method_choice_procedure.step_5: Else => STOP confirmatory admission. Report the failing sets and reasons. No third method, no mixing.
method_choice_procedure.binding: The method chosen and its parameters are frozen BEFORE confirmation unblinding; no method switching on confirmation data.
